form.notes: THE CONDITIONAL HUB. A gain on property used in a trade or business does NOT reach Schedule D directly. Form 4797 sorts it by character and holding period first, and only a Part I result reaches Schedule D line 11 — as a LONG-TERM capital gain, and only on one of two branches: (1) line 7 is a gain and there are no nonrecaptured prior-year section 1231 losses, so line 7 itself goes to Schedule D; or (2) line 9 is more than zero, so line 9 goes to Schedule D while line 8 goes to line 12 as ordinary. If line 7 is zero or a loss it goes to line 11 (Part II, ordinary) and reaches Schedule 1, not Schedule D. Part II's own total (line 18b) goes to Schedule 1 Part I line 4 and belongs to the ordinary-income part of the map. LINE 10 PRINTS NO COLUMN HEADERS OF ITS OWN: Part II is a bare grid under the seven columns (a)-(g) printed once above line 2, so line 10 carries the same columns and column_captions as line 2. Part III's property columns A-D (lines 20-29b) are INSTANCES, one per property on lines 19A-19D.
